reviews.title: How to start?
reviews.text:
Literally couldn’t figure out how to work it.
It opens up with a Calendar screen for the month, every day with a blank box…
No idea how to add shift hours, colour the boxes, how to create a repeating roster…
Almost everything I clicked on just came up with optional extras to purchase.

Gave up within a few minutes, deleted the app. Will seek something else.

As a point of reference, I have the “MyShiftPlanner“ app which was incredibly easy to use, very self-explanatory. The only reason I want a second one, is because I am working on a different shift line for three months, and I don’t want to rewrite my existing roster..

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: I purchased a pro version and got a new phone. I emailed them 2 weeks ago to restore purchase no response. I paid for a service that I can’t use.
